description.p: An instrument panel with large analog and digital gauges for CPU, RAM, any number of NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs, disks, network, fans, temperatures, power and audio levels, for Linux, Windows and macOS.

It shows N/A with the reason for any sensor your hardware or operating system does not expose, and never invents readings. Includes profiles, color themes, drag-to-reorder gauges, a Red Alert for dangerous system load, and an internet speed test with continuous testing and data limits.
